virtues.name: Second Sight
virtues.description: Perceives invisible and hidden things — and the residues of the dead.

virtues.name: Greater Immunity: cold & drowning
virtues.description: A creature of the cold northern sea; unharmed by cold and by drowning.

flaws.name: Essential Flaw: Avaricious (for knowledge)
flaws.description: Its dragon-avarice is not for gold but for KNOWLEDGE; it cannot leave a mystery, a grave, or an ancient bone alone.

reputations.name: The Worm in the Cliff (local, NE England) 3
reputations.description: Half-remembered in the coastal worm-legends of Northumbria (the Lambton, Sockburn, and Laidly Worms).

powers.name: Speak With Bones
powers.description: Its signature and the root of its error: it questions the dead and the ancient remains it hoards, drawing out memory and history from bone. This is how it found REAL traces of Jörmungandr — and over-read genuine scholarship into a personal genealogy it now sincerely, wrongly, believes.

powers.name: Peering Into the Mortal Mind
powers.description: Reads the mind of anyone it can see, with no eye contact needed (InMe 40). It reads the living and the memory-residue in bone alike.

powers.name: Breath of the Briny North Wind
powers.description: A cone of briny north wind that chills to the bone — the killing cold of the northern sea, out to 50 paces. Where Tormente burns and batters, Mímormr freezes.

powers.name: Poisonous Blood
powers.description: Its spilled blood stays a deadly poison for nine days; a wounding blow that then botches spatters a drop — Stamina 12+ or die.

Mímormr.vis: 9 pawns of Intellego vis in the heart.
Mímormr.appearance: A long, serpentine sea-wyrm — a squat body some 25 feet from shoulder to rump, a sinuous neck and a whip-like tail of like length — sheathed in SILVER scales hard as iron, shot through with hints of AQUAMARINE. It lairs in a sea-cliff cave above the waves off the English northeast coast, near Scarborough / Newcastle, and cannot leave it.
Mímormr.source: GM prep (2026-08-08). Built on Polymathes, the Draconic Librarian (Realms of Power: Magic p.76, Might 41 Animal) — the knowledge-hoard reskinned to bones, Master of Illusion replaced by Speak With Bones, Fiery Breath reskinned to the briny north wind, and a silver/aquamarine sea-wyrm body.
Mímormr.shortDescription: Cursed bone-speaking sea-wyrm off NE England; believes itself a child of Jörmungandr (magnitude ~8).
Mímormr.biography:
Mímormr is a scholar-wyrm: a researcher of ancient things that speaks with bones, curious to the point of recklessness, and — for many, many years — a prisoner. Its kin TORMENTE cursed it to stay put (The Staying Word), and it cannot leave its sea-cliff hole. It styles itself a CHILD OF JÖRMUNGANDR, the greatest magical being that ever was. That is false — but Jörmungandr did exist (Rán may know a rumor of it, c022), and Mímormr believes the descent utterly, because its own bone-divination turned up real traces and it wanted them to mean kinship. Genuine scholarship, wrong conclusion; the magi cannot easily disprove it.

STATBLOCK — Might 41 (Magic, Aquam); Magic Resistance 41; Size +7; Soak +24. Int +5, Per +4, Pre +8, Com +3, Str +12, Sta +8, Dex +3, Qik –4. Large Claws: Init +4, Attack +23, Defense +20, Damage +22. Large Teeth: Init +4, Attack +21, Defense +17, Damage +21. Vis: 9 pawns Intellego in the heart.

POWERS — Speak With Bones (Intellego; questions the dead); Peering Into the Mortal Mind (reads any mind in sight); Breath of the Briny North Wind (Auram cold cone); Poisonous Blood (Aquam).

IF FREED (see t066, t072): sits below Tormente (Might 41 vs 50), which is why Tormente could cage it. The Roman crown breaks the curse. Loose, its Size +7 bulk and restless, grave-cracking curiosity are an environmental catastrophe for the Northumbrian coast — sunk hulls, flooded shores, barrows torn open for bones, a killing cold in its wake — not necessarily hostile to the magi, but ruinous to be near. It is the seed of the region's worm-legends.

Capricorn.name: Capricorn

virtues.name: Magic Animal
virtues.description: A Magic-realm beast; Magic Resistance 14.

virtues.name: Gift of Speech
virtues.description: Can speak and understand language — a familiar you can actually converse with.

virtues.name: Second Sight
virtues.description: Sees the invisible, and the seams of magic regiones.

virtues.name: Ways of the (Sea)
virtues.description: At home on and under the water; unhindered by sea and shore alike.

flaws.name: Shy / Skittish
flaws.description: It courts on its own terms; it will not be caught, only won over.

powers.name: Threshold-Walker
powers.description: Its SIGNATURE: it senses the boundaries of magic regiones and can step across them at will — and, once bonded, carry or lead its magus across a regio threshold that would otherwise resist him. The reason a regio-probing covenant would prize it.

powers.name: Walk Upon the Waves
powers.description: Treads open water as though it were solid ground, and can bear a rider so.

powers.name: Breath of the Tide
powers.description: It, and one it touches, may breathe and see clearly underwater.

powers.name: Weather-Wit
powers.description: Senses the coming of storms and the safe passage through them — the sea-goat as living barometer (a quiet gift toward the covenant's maritime magic, t009).

Capricorn.vis: 2 pawns of Vim in the horns.
Capricorn.appearance: A sea-goat: the shaggy grey-green forequarters and curling, spiralled horns of a mountain goat giving way to a long, scaled fish-tail that flashes aquamarine in the water. It paces ships at the tide-line, keeping just off the rail, and singles out Éogan.
Capricorn.source: GM prep (2026-08-08). Built fresh as a familiar-scale Magic beast (Might 14, cf. the caladrius model in the magical bestiary), per t070. Draw on Éogan is independent of the t068 faerie affinity; what it wants for a bond is still open.
Capricorn.shortDescription: A Magic sea-goat (capricorn) — threshold-crosser and would-be familiar for Éogan. Unnamed until bonded.
Capricorn.biography:
On the sea-voyage home from Ireland, a capricorn — a Magic-realm sea-goat — singles Éogan out and paces his ship, keeping just off the rail. It is not the small faerie folk of t068 following him; this is a Might-bearing creature come on its own account, and it would be the first familiar prospect for any Sjórseiðr magus (t037). Courting it, and the binding lab-work after, are the real task — it will not be caught, only won over, and what it wants in exchange is not yet known.

STATBLOCK — Might 14 (Magic, Aquam); Magic Resistance 14; Size +1; Soak +4. Int 0, Per +3, Pre +1, Com +1, Str +1, Sta +2, Dex +1, Qik +2. Horns: Init +2, Attack +6, Defense +6, Damage +5. Vis: 2 pawns Vim in the horns.

POWERS — Threshold-Walker (senses and crosses regio boundaries, and carries its magus across); Walk Upon the Waves; Breath of the Tide (water-breathing); Weather-Wit (storm-sense).

LORE — the sea-goat is one of the oldest monsters recorded: the Babylonian Goat-Fish sacred to Enki/Ea, god of fresh water, wisdom and magic; and, via Macrobius, Capricorn is the Gate of the Gods, the solstitial gate — a threshold-creature by its very nature, which is why it walks between water, shore, and regio.

Rody.name: Rody

virtues.name: Faerie Sight
virtues.description: Sees other faeries and the workings of glamour for what they are.

virtues.name: Faerie Speech
virtues.description: Speaks and understands the tongues of those it dwells among (here, a rudimentary Latin among the magi).

virtues.name: Humanoid Faerie
virtues.description: A faerie in human shape, built on the Faerie rules.

virtues.name: Improved Characteristics
virtues.description: Its stolen seeming is more capable than a sickly changeling should be.

virtues.name: Observant
virtues.description: Watchful for the one thing that matters — being found out.

flaws.name: Dependant: a nurturing household
flaws.description: A changeling needs a place at a mortal hearth; the nurture it is given rejuvenates it. Cast out and unfed, it withers.

flaws.name: Needy, Sickly & Forever Hungry
flaws.description: The mark of a gerontified changeling: it is always ailing, always hungry, and pulls endlessly at the care of those around it.

flaws.name: Traditional Vulnerability
flaws.description: Revealed and driven off by the old customary means (iron, the hearth-ward, being made to laugh or to count) — the folk knowledge Wilhelm is circling.

powers.name: The Child’s Seeming
powers.description: Wears the convincing shape of the stolen Gifted boy — and counterfeits even the unsettling social aura of The Gift, which is how it passed as a Gifted child to those meant to receive it (this is the answer to q026). Second Sight or Faerie Sight pierces it; ordinary eyes do not.

powers.name: Pull at the Heart
powers.description: Its neediness is a glamour: those around it are moved to feed, shelter, and defend it, and the nurture rejuvenates the withered faerie beneath. This is why the party carries it east in good faith, and why folk pity rather than question it.

powers.name: The Stolen Thread
powers.description: A lingering sympathetic bond to the REAL Gifted child it replaced (t023, q026) — the traditional “connection between the life of the child and the life the changeling has stolen.” Not a weapon; a lead. Rightly read, it points back toward the missing child.

Rody.vis: 1 pawn Imaginem when its seeming breaks — and a withered, needy faerie thing (or a bundle of sticks) left where the boy was.
Rody.appearance: To ordinary eyes: Rody, a boy of about ten with a little rudimentary Latin, sickly and clinging and always hungry. To Second Sight or Faerie Sight: a gerontified faerie — withered, ancient, needy — wearing the boy’s shape like a borrowed coat.
Rody.source: GM prep (2026-08-08). Built on the Toy Soldier (Realms of Power: Faerie, Faerie Might 5) and tweaked into a changeling per RoP:Faerie’s “Gerontified Faerie” changeling rules — Size raised to a boy’s, Form shifted to Imaginem (the disguise is its essence), Might raised to 15 so a base-10 folk ward cannot reliably hold it, and the toy-soldier’s ward/loyalty traits swapped for the changeling’s glamour, neediness, and stolen-child bond.
Rody.shortDescription: A Faerie changeling wearing a Gifted boy’s shape — the real child is still missing (t023, q026).
Rody.biography:
Rody is a changeling: a gerontified faerie exchanged for a real Gifted child and wearing that child’s seeming. It was being delivered east — toward the Hill of Tara / the receiving Hermetic magi near Uisneach — as though it were the Gifted boy, until Éogan and Dustin confirmed the deception and brought Wilhelm in (p051). Its glamour counterfeits the very aura of The Gift, which is how it was mistaken for a Gifted child in the first place (q026); its neediness is itself a charm that makes its hosts nurture and shield it.

STATBLOCK — Might 15 (Faerie, Imaginem); Magic Resistance 15; Size –1; Soak 0. Int +1, Per +2, Pre +1, Com 0, Str –3, Sta –1, Dex 0, Qik +1. It is no fighter. Vis: 1 pawn Imaginem when the seeming breaks.

POWERS — The Child’s Seeming (the Gift-counterfeiting disguise); Pull at the Heart (the neediness-glamour that wins nurture); The Stolen Thread (a lingering bond to the real child it replaced).

THE WARD CLIFFHANGER (p051) — Wilhelm’s folk Ward against Faeries at roughly base level 10 is HIGHLY UNLIKELY to hold a changeling of Might 15: it can step out of the circle much as a human would, so the test is inconclusive either way — which is exactly the hanging note the scene ended on. THE MISSING CHILD (t023) — the real Gifted child is still out there, not necessarily harmed; The Stolen Thread is the way back to it.
